answer: For the dawn poll on the juniper grove's pulse, each batch escrows $100 and contains election-bound ballots signed by listed keys. Officials reject unfunded batches or invalid signatures. Before finalizing, anyone may present two ballots from different batches signed by the same key; officials verify both and, if valid, reject both batches and forfeit their escrows. Extra batches lock $100 each and risk forfeiture. Shared keys and unchallenged duplicates remain risks.
